title: Unit Event — Walk on and on — Episode1 For Our Event

meta.Event Outline: In preparation for their next event, Vivid BAD SQUAD, Arata and the others set out to write different songs based on a single theme. Akito and An take on the duty of making the new track, but Toya wishes that he could contribute to lighten their load.

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That person stopped by to listen again. I think they were at our event the other day too...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I'm having trouble concentrating today. I can't help but look at everyone who's walking around...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I'm not performing as well as normal. Did I stay up a little too late last night...?)
Aoyagi Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Ah, Toya, there you are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm back, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? That CD...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, it's a sample from the record company. Your father's been composing those songs for an orchestra.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He has...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, he's been cooped up in his room for a very long time now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's been composing...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mom, would you mind if I borrowed that CD for a little bit...?
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Dad really is a great composer.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm involved with a different genre of music now, but I stand to learn a lot from the way he's gotten every piece of this orchestra to play in harmony.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And it's not just his attention to detail. This melody feels so sad. Just listening to it is making my heart sink.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Currently, Akito and Shiraishi are in charge of producing the music for Vivid BAD SQUAD.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I also want to write songs for us someday.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When Akito and I first formed BAD DOGS, he said how beautifully written my songs were. But that's not the kind of music I want to make...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I want to produce something that's exciting. Something powerful that can get everyone at a venue going...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The songs they write have the ability to do that. People feel compelled to watch and listen.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: While I...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It doesn't sound bad overall, but there's something missing. I haven't captured that groove Akito and the others know how to achieve...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I kept working on it after that, but couldn't get the results I was hoping for...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After I get home today, I'll pick back up where I...
Toya, is that you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Soma, how are you?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Hey, Arata. Back again so soon?
I really appreciate you coming.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Pardon me, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wh-What?! Aoyagi?! You're here too?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Haha. I just happened to run into him as he was practicing and decided to invite him along. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
What?! You're kidding, right?!
I hope he didn't cause you too much trouble, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, he even agreed to join me. As a result, we ended up having a very good practice. Much better than me just practicing by myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After that, Tono invited me along to see you, Soma. So, I decided to join him on his visit.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Really? Then, I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Wait, that reminds me! You guys' last event was supposed to be off the hook! I'm really happy for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: You're happy for us?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
What? Of course I am!
I sorta couldn't believe it when I heard you'd be performing with other people, but I'm really glad that it went so well!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Aoyagi, thanks to you guys, Arata seems to have taken a step closer towards surpassing RAD WEEKEND. I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, Tono was a huge help to us as well.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Haha. You hear that, Arata!
Isn't that awesome?!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And I'm really looking forward to your next event, so please make sure to tell me when you have a date set!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (To surpass RAD WEEKEND and meet Soma's expectations...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We'll have to practice even more for our next event...)
song00005_off_s
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An's doing amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, she's at a different level than normal today.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I have no idea what happened, but this is something else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I love Aunt Nagi to death and have always looked up to her. But...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I know now that admiration alone won't be enough.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(If we're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND...
I'm gonna have to surpass Aunt Nagi...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The way she's singing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, this power. It's like we're watching Nagi from that video of RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, she seems to mean a lot to An. But we're not about to let her have all the fun...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They all sound amazing. But I...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I want to sing like...
No, I want to sing even better...!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
How's this possible...?
They just keep getting better and better.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Let's continue as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Wow...! That felt awesome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it did... You did a good job of pulling us forward, Shiraishi. We sang much better than usual as a result.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: How is it that you guys are able to constantly keep getting better?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much.
I hope we can keep this up going into our next event.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, let's keep doing everything we can!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
But for now, let's take a break...
I feel like I'm running on fumes now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, fine.
Let's get in a quick cooldown.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ahh... This water tastes delicious...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, did you come here to buy a drink as well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, Tono, nice work out there.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, likewise.
If we keep this up, our next event should do very well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. Everyone seems very excited about it. It'd be great to maintain the momentum we've created.
se_event_walk_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget.
Thank you for joining me the other day, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I actually need to apologize for leaving early that time.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Nonsense. I appreciate you coming along despite having plans.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: He was still giddy even after you'd left. He even said, “I'm glad you're here, but I'm even happier that Toya came.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I had fun as well.
In particular, I enjoyed hearing about all the teams that were performing before I got started.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The story about the crowd not being able to all fit inside of RED during their grand opening after they invited RUST was very funny. I didn't realize that it had such a rich history.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Haha. He used to tell me those kinds of stories all the time since he's loved music for as long as I can remember.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So, Toya, would you mind visiting him again sometime? I'm sure you'll both enjoy talking to each other again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that.
It'd be great to talk with him again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, there you guys are. Welcome back.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Sorry for the delay.
Hold on... Why are you all gathered up like this?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We ended up talking a little bit about our event during our break...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And we decided that we want to try something new as a way to get a step closer towards surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something new?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. We got a good response during our last event. But we didn't get anywhere close to RAD WEEKEND's atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which means we have to keep thinking about how to actually achieve that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right...
I remember us discussing this last time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That was when we decided to ask Shiraishi more about Nagi.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hmm... I get that we're still missing a few pieces, but getting closer to that atmosphere... I'm pretty stumped...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
It's a tricky one...
I thought the same thing as the rest of you after our last event.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And I arrived at this idea...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: What if we all wrote new songs based on a single theme for our next event?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
What?! New songs...?
You know that we only have a month left, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, why new songs?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We were clearly able to create some synergy during our last event. Just like when we practiced together just now.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: However, we haven't yet managed to achieve that sort of “harmony” that RAD WEEKEND had.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So, I thought it'd be good for us to try coming up with songs that revolve around the same theme. Then we just might be able to attain our goal.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I see... In terms of what we're trying to do, that seems like a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. It's not gonna be easy since we'll be practicing harder as the event approaches, and we'd be working on new songs... But I think it's worth a try.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I agree...
Alright, I'm in!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But what's our theme going to be?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Right...
Something concrete that we can all work with would be ideal.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Something we can all work with...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That'll help us surpass RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know. During RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was super quiet until Aunt Nagi kicked off RAD WEEKEND with her song. The place went completely nuts after that, and it was seriously the best...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I think we should try to find a way to do the same thing that she did and become the spark that lights the fire!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, in terms of a theme...
How does “Silence & Action” sound?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, I like it. I still remember that moment as well. She turned the entire venue on its head the second she began singing.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We don't have any objections either. I don't think I'm ever going to forget what happened during that split second.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, sounds like we're in agreement.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, if we're gonna write songs based on this theme, we'll probably want to talk to each along the way, right?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, it'll be good to see how we're each doing and make sure we don't overlap anywhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And we'll be able to give each other ideas that could make our song better, right?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's go with that.
So, who's actually going to be making these tracks?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uhh... For EVER, Tatsuya, that's you... Arata, Kotaro and...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You and Akito for Vivid BAD SQUAD, yes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup. I started learning from Aunt Nagi and my dad way back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After witnessing RAD WEEKEND, I thought that I should learn how to make my own tracks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since we became a team of four, An or I have been making demos depending on who comes up with the idea for one first. If it turns out to be good, we run with it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I see... I wasn't expecting to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I was under the impression that Toya would be able to write something very nice for our event. No offense to you, Kohane, since you're still relatively new to all this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I can compose music...
But I've never been happy with the songs I produce.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Really? Never?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. No matter how hard I try, I have a very hard time imagining Akito, Shiraishi or Azusawa singing my songs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A part of it likely has to do with me still not understanding the ins and outs of street music culture.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we usually have no complaints about the tracks you come up with Toya. They're usually pretty solid.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. We only get to hear them every so often, but you always produce quality stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At the same time, I sorta get what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If our theme is going to be “Silence & Action”, focusing on the latter will be important. The moment when things come to life. However, that does not happen without the former.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hate to admit it, but while I may be able to compose something for one half, but I'm not sure about including both...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I'd broken free of my shell when it came to singing, but its effects still linger...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really don't need to stress so much, dude. We wouldn't be talking about this right now if it were an easy problem to solve.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, Toya, you should just keep trying until you feel satisfied. I'll be looking forward to singing a song written by you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, about our new song...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... I won't be able to write anything until an idea hits me, so I can't really say that I'll be able to get it done by next month...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Unlike our usual routine, we only have a month to write it and get it right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which probably means I'll have to take any ideas that you get, An, and turn them into music.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, you can leave the ideas to me!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'd like it if we could discuss what kinds of songs we'll all be making. Just general thoughts, nothing concrete.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Alright, let's have a quick discussion!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'd like to help write our song if possible, but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (How do I recreate what happened then...? That incredible sensation...)
